== Overview ==

The '''Multi-Cannon''' is an ammunition-fed kinetic weapon that fires a sustained stream of projectiles. It combines low power, distributor, and thermal demands with a large ammunition reserve, making it easy to operate alongside energy weapons.<ref name="edcd">EDCD, [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EDCD/coriolis-data/d0f20ca17805588d77c1978fff99a01280dc2d22/modules/hardpoints/multi_cannon.json Coriolis Multi-Cannon module data], accessed 2026-09-16.</ref>

Kinetic damage is most effective after shields have been removed. Against hull, the weapon's effectiveness depends partly on the relationship between its armour-piercing value and the target's armour hardness. Larger Multi-Cannons have greater piercing and therefore lose less damage against hard targets.

A Multi-Cannon is not a [[Cannon]]. Multi-Cannons apply damage through many small impacts and reward sustained time on target; Cannons fire much more slowly and concentrate more damage into each shell.

== Variants and specifications ==

Standard Multi-Cannons are available in classes 1–4. Classes 1–3 support fixed, gimballed, and turreted mounts; class 4 supports fixed and gimballed mounts.<ref name="edcd" />

All standard variants launch projectiles at 1,600 m/s, begin damage falloff at 2,000 metres, and have a maximum range of 4,000 metres.<ref name="edcd" /> The class 4 weapons fire two projectiles per firing cycle, accounting for their slower listed volley rate.

=== Mount choice ===

* '''Fixed''' Multi-Cannons provide the greatest damage and ignore chaff, but the ship must be aimed to lead the target.
* '''Gimballed''' Multi-Cannons track within a forward arc. They trade damage for easier sustained fire and are disrupted by chaff.
* '''Turreted''' Multi-Cannons provide the widest tracking arc and multicrew support, but have the lowest direct damage and are unavailable in class 4.

== Operation ==

Classes 1–3 spin up before firing. Releasing the trigger during spin-up stops the cycle without firing, so these weapons work best when the pilot can hold the target in the firing arc for a sustained burst.<ref name="edwiki">Elite Dangerous Wiki, [https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Multi-cannon Multi-cannon], accessed 2026-09-16.</ref> Class 4 variants fire heavier two-projectile volleys without the same spin-up delay.

The weapon's low distributor demand allows it to continue firing when a laser-heavy group would be constrained by the WEP capacitor. Its finite ammunition and four- or five-second reload interruptions still limit endurance. Station rearming restores ammunition, while standard Multi-Cannon ammunition synthesis can replenish an individual weapon in the field.

The 2,000-metre falloff point is a practical threshold rather than the weapon's maximum reach. Damage declines beyond it until the projectile reaches the 4,000-metre limit. Projectile travel time and target motion also reduce the usefulness of long-range fire.

== Engineering ==

Standard Multi-Cannons support eight conventional blueprint families:<ref name="edwiki" /><ref name="inara-overcharged">INARA, [https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/57/ Multi-Cannon — Overcharged], accessed 2026-09-16.</ref>

* Efficient;
* High Capacity;
* Lightweight;
* Long Range;
* Overcharged;
* Rapid Fire;
* Short Range; and
* Sturdy.

Compatible Experimental Effects are Auto Loader, Corrosive Shell, [[Double Braced]], [[Emissive Munitions]], [[Flow Control]], Incendiary Rounds, [[Multi-servos]], [[Oversized]], Smart Rounds, [[Stripped Down]], and Thermal Shock.<ref name="inara-overcharged" />

Notable choices include:

* '''Overcharged''' substantially increases damage at the cost of power draw, distributor demand, thermal load, and magazine capacity.
* '''High Capacity''' improves ammunition endurance and magazine size, which is useful for long engagements or ammunition-reducing Experimental Effects.
* '''Long Range''' increases projectile speed and moves falloff to the enlarged maximum range, making distant targets easier to lead and removing ordinary range-based damage loss before that limit.
* '''Corrosive Shell''' reduces the struck target's effective hull hardness and increases incoming hull damage, but reduces the weapon's ammunition capacity.
* '''Incendiary Rounds''' converts most damage to thermal, allowing a Multi-Cannon to contribute more effectively against shields at the cost of added thermal load.
* '''Auto Loader''' reloads continuously while the weapon operates, reducing magazine downtime without increasing the reserve.

[[Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn]] and [[Marsha Hicks]] provide Multi-Cannon Engineering through Grade 5. [[Zacariah Nemo]] provides it through Grade 3.<ref name="inara-overcharged" />

== Acquisition ==

Standard Multi-Cannons are ordinary credit purchases through Outfitting and require no unlock. Station stock determines which classes and mounts are available at a particular location.

Specialised relatives are separate modules with their own acquisition and behavior. The [[Enforcer Cannon]] is a Powerplay class 1 fixed variant, while the [[AX Multi-Cannon]] and [[Enhanced AX Multi-Cannon]] are anti-xeno weapons rather than conventional kinetic Multi-Cannons.
